scope: Affirmative contribution-first exposition; unchanged scientific evidence

changes.before: This companion study separates exact construction labels from unknown real-world audibility. Fully synthetic scenes comprise colored ambient noise and zero, one or two harmonic, amplitude-modulated or chirped sources. Received supports include bounded multipath delay. Overlapping source supports are merged into the union of activity for temporal scoring. A union-activity detector does not resolve overlapping physical objects. The separately trained temporal spectral CNN supplies the fully/semi-synthetic results; these do not test Qwen/flow benefit.
changes.after: This companion study provides controlled reference tests for choosing acoustic representations. Fully synthetic scenes comprise colored ambient noise and zero, one or two harmonic, amplitude-modulated or chirped sources. Exact construction labels identify received supports, including bounded multipath delay. Overlapping source supports are merged into the union of activity for temporal scoring. The separately trained temporal spectral CNN evaluates fully/semi-synthetic activity unions, treating overlapping sources as one scored interval.

changes.before: The focused representation study uses three-second controlled clips and fixed detection heads for STFT, STFT plus wavelets, STFT plus bounded HHT, and all views. It separates training/development/test generation identities and a held-out signal family. Presence AP in this study is not temporal AP and does not directly establish a reasoning-agent benefit. HHT remains an explicitly exploratory approximation.
changes.after: The focused representation study uses three-second controlled clips and fixed detection heads for STFT, STFT plus wavelets, STFT plus bounded HHT, and all views. It separates training/development/test generation identities and a held-out signal family. Presence AP measures recording-level discrimination; temporal AP measures interval detection. The bounded HHT branch supplies an explicitly exploratory comparison.

changes.before: Temporal AP uses greedy confidence-ordered one-to-one matching with the monotone precision envelope. Duplicate predictions count as false positives; classes with no ground-truth events are excluded from mAP and their false positives remain reported. Thresholded event F1 and presence discrimination are additional outcomes, not replacements for a failed temporal endpoint.
changes.after: Temporal AP uses greedy confidence-ordered one-to-one matching with the monotone precision envelope. Duplicate predictions count as false positives; classes with no ground-truth events are excluded from mAP and their false positives remain reported. Thresholded event F1 and presence discrimination complement the separately reported temporal endpoint.

changes.before: No human-verified real temporal intervals were available in this execution. Therefore this supplement makes no claim of real event-boundary accuracy, range/bearing localization, source identity or silent-object detection.
changes.after: The labels define constructed activity and vessel-associated recording windows; human-verified real temporal intervals, range/bearing, source identity and silent objects are outside their scope.

changes.before: The bounded GPU EMD approximation uses up to six modes and ten sifts, piecewise-linear envelopes and masked instantaneous-frequency summaries. It is not relabeled as classical cubic-spline EMD. HHT remains exploratory because the noisy-scene convergence gate failed.
changes.after: Numerical checks distinguish reconstruction accuracy from valid extracted modes. The bounded GPU EMD approximation uses up to six modes and ten sifts, piecewise-linear envelopes and masked instantaneous-frequency summaries. It is evaluated as a piecewise-linear approximation to classical cubic-spline EMD. Noisy-scene convergence failures define its exploratory scope.

changes.before: Measured numerical fixtures only. The 440 Hz frequency check and small reconstruction errors do not repair the noisy-scene mode failures. The combined flagged-mode fraction includes nonconvergence and extrema failures.
changes.after: Numerical fixtures distinguish accurate tone recovery and reconstruction from noisy-scene mode validity. The 440 Hz check succeeds; the combined flagged-mode fraction records nonconvergence and extrema failures.

changes.before: The FFT/Hilbert and wavelet calculations ran on the selected Ada GPU. The small independent spline reference ran on CPU solely as a correctness fixture. Edge effects, mode mixing and low-amplitude instantaneous-frequency instability remain relevant. Exact reconstruction tests summation consistency and cannot establish physically meaningful decomposition.
changes.after: The FFT/Hilbert and wavelet calculations ran on the selected Ada GPU. The small independent spline reference ran on CPU solely as a correctness fixture. Exact reconstruction verifies summation consistency; mode interpretation additionally depends on convergence, edge effects, mode mixing and low-amplitude instantaneous-frequency stability.

changes.before: Presence-detection AP for the focused representation study and missing-view tests. Points show available seeds; short horizontal markers are seed means. Missing-view curves retain each family separately. HHT remains exploratory after the numerical convergence failure.
changes.after: Presence-detection AP for the focused representation study and missing-view tests. Points show available seeds; short horizontal markers are seed means. Missing-view curves retain each family separately. The exploratory HHT branch shows why classification scores and numerical convergence require separate assessment.

changes.before: Mean AP by controlled source regime. Regimes are synthetic forms, not vessel classes. Two-source scenes include overlapping and nonoverlapping supports; interval overlap is not required.
changes.after: Mean AP by controlled source regime. Regimes describe synthetic source forms. Two-source scenes include overlapping and nonoverlapping supports; interval overlap is optional.

changes.before: Generative replacement can erase all activity in the editable interval. A matched sham may preserve the original waveform additively while still masking it perceptually. Accordingly, detector changes are sensitivity measurements. Generator uncertainty, boundary distortion and invalid replacements must remain visible in the evaluation.
changes.after: Paired generated and matched sham edits quantify detector sensitivity to waveform changes. A replacement can erase all activity within its interval; an additive sham can retain the original signal while masking its audibility. Recording generator uncertainty, boundary distortion and invalid replacements makes these comparisons interpretable.

changes.before: Numerical pilot timing. These are single synchronized tensor-resident calls with unequal first-use overhead, not a warmed throughput comparison.
changes.after: Numerical pilot timing for single synchronized tensor-resident calls. Unequal first-use overhead makes these implementation diagnostics; the main study reports warmed throughput separately.

changes.before: The unconstrained development replay had 50.0\% valid actions across 4,220 actions from 2,110 clip-seed records (including partial runs). It failed by proposing already observed STFT after wavelet acquisition. This engineering failure and its traces are preserved. Before test evaluation, the controller was amended to finite legal-JSON token-trie decoding, enforcing schema validity by construction and retaining the independent parser. EOS is required, observed tools are excluded, and no retries choose a favorable action. The 160-state GPU fixture checks integration, not reasoning competence. All 3,600 test clip-seed paths were wavelet, Fourier, then verify; generation informed no later action and did not demonstrate adaptive selection.
changes.after: Preserved development traces guided a reproducible controller correction before test evaluation. The unconstrained replay had 50.0\% valid actions across 4,220 actions from 2,110 clip-seed records (including partial runs). Requests for already observed STFT after wavelet acquisition identified the integration defect. Finite legal-JSON token-trie decoding then enforced schema validity by construction, retaining the independent parser. EOS is required and observed tools are excluded; actions are accepted without favorable-outcome retries. The 160-state GPU fixture checks this integration property. All 3,600 test clip-seed paths were wavelet, Fourier, then verify, providing an explicit fixed-sequence reference; generated evidence entered final scoring after tool acquisition.

changes.before: The controlled study successfully quantified representation performance across signal families and missing-input conditions. Across three detector seeds, STFT reached mean presence AP 0.995 on in-family test scenes and 0.880 on the held-out generated family, making sensitivity to changed conditions measurable. Numerical checks also prevented a high-scoring but unstable bounded HHT approximation from entering the primary analysis: accurate reconstruction did not imply converged components. These outcomes provide tested baselines and repeatable checks for developing acoustic representations. They concern constructed labels and do not establish natural-event accuracy or a reasoning-agent benefit. Interpretation remains bounded by vessel-tracking labels, artificial class balance, a fixed generator seed, one deployment and one connected test component; AP, precision and calibration remain cohort-specific.
changes.after: The controlled study supplies tested baselines and repeatable checks for acoustic representation design. Across three detector seeds, STFT reached mean presence AP 0.995 on in-family test scenes and 0.880 on the held-out generated family, quantifying sensitivity to changed conditions. Missing-input tests extend this comparison to incomplete evidence. Numerical checks distinguished accurate reconstruction from converged modes, keeping the high-scoring bounded HHT approximation exploratory. Together, these results make representation choice and numerical reliability separately assessable. Interpretation follows the labels and sampling design: constructed activity, vessel-tracking presence, artificial class balance, a fixed generator seed, one deployment and one connected test component. AP, precision and calibration describe this cohort.
